name: Bharat Electronics Ltd
title: Bharat Electronics Ltd - 500049 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: BEL guides FY27 revenue growth above 15% and EBITDA margin above 28%, with order inflow above INR55,000 crore, though QRSAM timing and a flat order book cloud visibility.

utilisation.quote: we are not seeing any choking for us for next few years, maybe 3 to 5 years

capex.quote: this year, anyway, I will tell you at the end, it will be definitely much more than that

triggers.label: FY27 order inflow above INR55,000 cr
triggers.quote: The order inflow we are expecting this year more than INR55,000 crores.

triggers.label: QRSAM signing by June end
triggers.quote: we are still fully optimistic that before June end, we may get this order.

triggers.label: Receivables 140-150 days range
triggers.quote: receivables have gone up in the current year as compared to last year.

guidance.quote: we are retaining our revenue growth of more than 15%.
EBITDA margins will be more than 28%.
The order inflow we are expecting this year more than INR55,000 crores.
we are targeting more than INR1,200 crores as a capital investment for this year.
this year, we have targeted a value of around INR2,200 crores investment in R&D.
defense to non-defense ratio, more or less, it will be 90% to 10%, maybe plus/minus 1%.

prior_guidance_check.quote: we have met all the guidance parameters in the last financial year.

red_flags.label: Receivables up ~30 days, OCF/EBITDA ~19%
red_flags.quote: receivables have gone up in the current year as compared to last year.

red_flags.label: Order book flat, inflows ~ revenue
red_flags.quote: your order book has not grown this year. In fact, it has been flat for some time

evasions.topic: FY27 margin and provisioning impact of wage revision
evasions.quote: When we give guidance, we take care of all the parameters.

evasions.topic: Operating cash flow to EBITDA conversion
evasions.quote: all I can say is the current cash position is reasonably okay for us

evasions.topic: Order inflow and base order timing deferred to closing remarks
evasions.quote: that anyway I will tell in my closing remarks
